notes.title: Healing Simulator is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928251/ab8d0f23e424f5671448296d714f0695896cd2c7.png[/img]
Hello everyone!
It's April 5th and Healing Simulator is now finally released on Steam! 

The plan for the game: To observe how the release goes and plan eventual future updates based on the launch.

If you have any improvement suggestions or encounter any bugs, please report it in Steam discussions
or by any other means. I want to hear your thoughts on the game!

Happy healing!
- Jens

notes.title: Healing Simulator Release Date: April 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928251/d78b82d24576564f0c8b69c01f66121e712e7c3b.png[/img]
The official release date for Healing Simulator on Steam will be April 5th 2022. Make sure to wishlist today and not to miss the launch discount!
